items.name: 06b-ledged-door-open-inside
items.prompt: Edit this photo: keep the same hallway, staircase, camera position and lighting. Open the sage green ledged under stairs cupboard door: it swings out into the hallway on its black T hinges on the left vertical edge, so we see the back of the door with the same angled top edge. Inside the cupboard is now visible and tidy: the sloping underside of the stairs as the ceiling, a small warm LED strip light, three coats on a row of hooks at the tall end, a stick vacuum standing in a wall bracket, and two plain woven baskets on a low shelf at the short end. Keep the door the same size and shape as the opening. No people, no text, no logos. Photorealistic.
